How to Bet on the WNBA at FanDuel

Whether you're a new fan or a seasoned bettor, here are the top ways to engage with WNBA action:

WNBA Moneylines: Bet on which team will win the game outright. Odds are shown with a minus (-) for favorites and a plus (+) for underdogs.

  • Example: Aces -160 means you wager $160 to win $100.
  • Liberty +140 means a $100 bet wins $140 if they pull off the upset.

WNBA Point Spreads: The spread helps even out the matchup by assigning points to each team.

  • Wings +5.5 (-110) means they can lose by 5 or less—or win for your bet to cash.
  • Sun -5.5 (-110) means they must win by 6+ points to cover.

WNBA Totals (Over/Under): Bet on the combined total score of both teams.

  • If the total is 162.5, betting the Over wins if the game hits 163+ points.

WNBA Prop Bets and Same Game Parlays: FanDuel offers a growing selection of WNBA prop markets based on team and player performance, including:

WNBA Odds and Betting FAQs


  • Do WNBA overtime points count toward my bets?

    Yes, unless otherwise stated, overtime counts for all WNBA markets including totals, spreads, and player props.

  • What happens to a WNBA bet if the game is postponed or suspended?

    If a WNBA game is not completed within 24 hours of the original scheduled start time, all bets will be void unless the outcome of a specific market has already been determined

  • Are WNBA player prop bets valid if the listed player doesn’t play?

    No. For player markets, all listed players must be active for wagers to stand. If a player doesn’t take the court, bets on that player will be refunded.

  • Can I include WNBA games in a parlay?

    Yes, WNBA games can be part of a parlay. However, if one leg of the parlay is void (e.g., due to player non-participation), the parlay will adjust accordingly. Example: a 3-leg parlay becomes a 2-leg parlay

WNBA Championship Betting: Odds to Win WNBA Championship

Who Has the Best Odds to Win the 2026 WNBA Championship?

The New York Liberty are the current favorites to win the 2026 WNBA Championship at +230 odds. The Las Vegas Aces sit second at +420, with Indiana Fever and Atlanta Dream both listed at +550. The Minnesota Lynx round out the top five at +900. Check back throughout the 2026 WNBA season as trades, injuries, and results continue to shape these futures odds.

These odds are subject to change as the season progresses. All wagers are available on the FanDuel Sportsbook app and website.


WNBA Championship Point Spreads and Lines

Once we know which two WNBA teams will play in the WNBA Finals, FanDuel Sportsbook will release WNBA Finals game lines and point spreads for each game. This will be similar to the everyday WNBA game odds seen during the regular season and throughout the WNBA Playoffs.

Any favorite’s point spread is displayed with a “minus” symbol next to a whole number or a halved fraction, such as (-4) or (-4.5). Gamblers picking the favorite “against the spread” must hope that the team wins by more than 4 points – a 1, 2, or 3-point victory or a straight-up loss loses the wager. An underdog’s point spread is displayed with a “+” symbol, indicating the number of points “spotted” to the team before the game kicks off. Underdog point-spread gamblers are hoping that the team will “cover” by winning by any amount or losing by any amount smaller than the betting line. If the underdog’s point spread is (+6) and the club loses by 5 points, the bettors still win the payout.

If a game finishes with the favorites winning by the exact line margin shown on the point spread, bets are returned in an outcome known as a “push.”

Reading the WNBA Championship Moneyline Odds

Moneyline odds promise a % payoff when a gambler’s chosen team wins the game straight-up. A favorite’s moneyline WNBA Championship odds are denoted with a “-“ as in (-200). Underdog moneylines are marked with a “+” as in a ML of (+350). Payoff is calculated differently for the betting odds in the favorite’s and underdog’s markets, but always centered around the value of $100

For instance, (-200) WNBA Finals odds mean that for every $200 wagered on a team, the house will pay out $100 if that team wins. (-500) odds stand for $100 payoff on every $500 wagered at the betting book. On the WNBA Finals underdog side, moneyline odds represent the amount paid out on won $100 bets if the team surprises. (+350) odds equal a $350 payout on $100, (+1000) odds represent $1000 payout on the same risk, and so on.
